$comment: Shared golden fixtures for the SCVal -> typed mapping used by the M1 trace decoder (libs). The XDR bytes for each canonical type are produced by the soroban Env at test time and asserted byte-stable; the `expected_json` column is the typed JSON the decoder must produce for each canonical type named in docs/SERIALIZATION_STANDARDS.md. The decoder must load this file and the *.xdr fixtures from tests/xdr-fixtures/ so both sides verify the same encoding contract.

types.note: Option encode: None serialises as SCVal::Void, never a sentinel number
Some(T) serialises as SCVal::T and is distinguishable from None
